Raises cash and removes near-term leasing and capex risk from low-occupancy assets.
Confirms execution on disposition program; adds liquidity this quarter.
Illustrates weak income from the asset; sale reduces re-leasing risk.
Eliminates carrying costs and lease-up uncertainty from a non-income property.
Gives flexibility for debt reduction or operations; impact depends on use.

This extends HPP’s ongoing strategy to recycle out of non-core, challenged SF office assets amid weak demand. A larger catalyst would be evidence of balance sheet de-risking (e.g., debt paydown) or material lease-up progress improving cash flow.
